excerpt.zh: 我们的间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经整理总结了结果，事关我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上掩盖星际生命存在的行动。
excerpt.en: Our Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has outlined the results of our operation to cover up the existence of interstellar life on [target.capital_scope.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们的间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]已经整理总结了结果，事关我们在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上掩盖星际生命存在的行动。
texts.en: Our Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has outlined the results of our operation to cover up the existence of interstellar life on [target.capital_scope.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的优秀特工已消除有关航天文明的猜测。现在传播外星人的故事会迅速被当成失心疯而遭到排挤。
texts.en: Our skilled operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have eliminated speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. Sharing alien stories is now a fast way of becoming ostracized as a delusional outsider.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的优秀特工已消除有关航天文明的猜测。几乎没有[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会再考虑外星生命的可能性了。
texts.en: Our skilled operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have eliminated speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. Few [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] even consider the possibility of life from other planets.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的优秀特工已消除有关航天文明的猜测。虽然一些身居要职的人可能会怀疑我们是真实存在的，但他们知道最好不要公开谈论那些会被视为谬论的想法。
texts.en: Our skilled operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have eliminated speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, they know better than to speak publicly on what would be seen as ridiculous notions.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的优秀特工已消除有关航天文明的猜测。虽然一些身居要职的人可能会怀疑我们是真实存在的，但他们知道最好不要公开谈论那些会被视为谬论的想法。
texts.en: Our skilled operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have eliminated speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, they know better than to speak publicly on what would be seen as ridiculous notions.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的特工已显著减少有关航天文明的猜测。现在传播外星人的故事会被当成是避犹不及之举。
texts.en: Our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have significantly reduced speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. Sharing alien stories is now considered a shun-worthy eccentricity.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的特工已显著减少有关航天文明的猜测。几乎没有[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]会费心考虑外星生命存在的可能性了。
texts.en: Our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have significantly reduced speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. Few [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] care to consider the possibility of alien life.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的特工已显著减少有关航天文明的猜测。尽管一些身居要职的人可能会怀疑我们是真实存在的，但他们不大会公开谈论这些事情了。
texts.en: Our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have significantly reduced speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, they are unlikely to speak publicly about such things.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]的特工已显著减少有关航天文明的猜测。尽管一些身居要职的人可能会怀疑我们是真实存在的，但他们不大会公开谈论这些事情了。
texts.en: Our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have significantly reduced speculation on the evidence of spacefaring civilizations. While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, they are unlikely to speak publicly about such things.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。有关星际访客存在的故事甚嚣尘上。
texts.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. The popularity of stories about the existence of interstellar visitors is increasing rapidly.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]仍公开传播外星人的存在，不少民众信以为真。
texts.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. The [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] still talk openly about the existence of aliens, and many believe such tales to be fact.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。那些身居要职的人公开谈论外星访客。他们基本肯定我们的存在。
texts.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. Those in positions of power talk openly about visitors from the stars. They are almost certain we exist.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。那些身居要职的人公开谈论外星访客。他们基本肯定我们的存在。
texts.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. Those in positions of power talk openly about visitors from the stars. They are almost certain we exist.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。有关星际访客存在的故事逐渐被公众遗忘，被视作持阴谋论的少数派一厢情愿的妄想。
texts.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. Stories about the existence of interstellar visitors are being dismissed as the delusions of a paranoid minority.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然在低声传诵外星人存在的证据，但是已经没什么人相信这些传说了。
texts.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. The [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural] still whisper about the existence of aliens, but few truly believe such tales.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。尽管一些掌权的高层可能质疑我们是真实存在的，但我们成功蒙蔽住了老百姓。
texts.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, the secret remains concealed to the public.

texts.zh: 我们在[this.capital_scope.GetName]上的特工通过努力，成功让当地人开始怀疑目前为止所发现的外星生命的证据。尽管一些掌权的高层可能质疑我们是真实存在的，但我们成功蒙蔽住了老百姓。
texts.en: The efforts of our operatives on [this.capital_scope.GetName] have cast doubt on the evidence of alien life found so far. While some in positions of power may suspect our existence, the secret remains concealed to the public.
